scenario.title: A feature release silently changes a unit the model was trained on
scenario.summary: feature-service 1.8.0 writes the load features (lags, means) in kW for a partner export; column names and schema are unchanged and the model was trained on MW. The raw demand data is fine, so every input check passes; every request succeeds; but forecasts shift, and only the output checks (stability vs the published plan) notice.

ground_truth.root_cause: feature-service 1.8.0 serves load features in kW to a model trained on MW (training/serving skew); forecasts shift with no errors
expected_evidence: input data checks pass (raw demand in MW is fine)
forecast-service, model registry and weather vendors unchanged
verification: forecasts back in line with the plan
